Privacy Policy

Published and last updated: 11 July 2026 · Author: Marcus Aragbaye

The short version

This is the personal portfolio website of Marcus Aragbaye (Marcdaddy). It is fully static: it collects no personal data, sets no cookies, runs no analytics, and includes no third-party tracking scripts of any kind. You can browse every page without telling us anything about yourself.

What this site does not do

  • No account creation, sign-in, or user profiles.
  • No contact forms, comment boxes, or newsletter sign-ups that store your details.
  • No cookies, local-storage identifiers, or device fingerprinting.
  • No advertising, remarketing pixels, or third-party analytics of any kind.
  • No embedded third-party widgets — all fonts, images, and videos are served from our own domain.

What is unavoidably processed

Like every website, the servers that deliver these pages briefly process the technical information your browser sends with each request — your IP address, browser user agent, and the pages requested. This happens solely to serve the pages, keep them fast, and protect them from abuse. That information is never used to identify or profile visitors.

Hosting and sub-processors

Hosting is provided by Vercel Inc. (Vercel Edge Network), which acts as the sole hosting sub-processor and data processor for the standard server logs described above. Vercel's handling of that data is described in the Vercel privacy policy and its data processing addendum. No other sub-processors are used.

External links

These pages link out to external services — YouTube, LinkedIn, X, project websites, and a cal.com booking page. Once you follow one of those links, the destination service's own privacy policy applies. No personal information is passed to those services when you click a link.

Your rights

Because no personal data is collected or stored, there is nothing for us to access, correct, export, or delete on your behalf. If you believe you have a privacy concern, contact the owner directly and it will be looked into promptly.

Changes to this policy

If the site ever adds features that change any of the above (for example a contact form or analytics), this policy will be updated first and the "last updated" date at the top revised.

Contact

Questions about this policy: marcus@marcdaddy.com. You can also find Marcus via the links on the home page.
